result.title: Completion-Aware Cross-Fidelity Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Line Bus Holding
result.summary: Exploratory reinforcement learning (RL) on an operating bus fleet is impractical,while policies trained only from historical data cannot acquire new experience. Hybrid Offline-and-Online (H2O) RL combines fixed target replay with simulator interaction, but the inexpensive online simulator can differ from the target in transition and event-duration dynamics. We study this cross-fidelity problem for multi-line bus holding and address a failure mode in which lower generalized passenger time coexists with incomplete passenger journeys.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究多线路公交驻站控制中的跨保真度离线到在线强化学习，针对在线模拟器与目标环境动态不一致导致的乘客行程不完整问题提出改进。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是交通调度策略的离线-在线 RL 训练，未涉及视觉或多模态推理的内部状态、证据筛选或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少具体可借鉴的状态或生成机制联系。
